nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step handover.
GreenEarthEconomyFund.symbol public string, set to 'GEE' in the constructor.
GreenEarthEconomyFund.name public string, set to 'Green Earth Economy Fund'.
GreenEarthEconomyFund.decimals public uint8, set to 18.
GreenEarthEconomyFund._totalSupply: total token supply minted to the deployer address.
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances per account.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition used for balance credits.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction used for balance/allowance debits.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): checked division.
Owned() constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: sets the pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner and finalizes ownership.
GreenEarthEconomyFund() constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address.
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] unconditionally.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balances.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns the stored allowance.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then calls spender.receiveApproval, an external call after state change.
Fallback function: payable and always reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: owner-driven external call to an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance keys.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens): balance debit arithmetic.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens): balance credit arithmetic.
c = a * b with overflow guard a == 0 || c / a == b inside safeMul.
ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...): external call to an attacker-supplied contract after the allowance write (reentrancy surface).
ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens): owner-privileged external call to an arbitrary contract address.
require(msg.sender == owner) inside the onlyOwner modifier: access-control gate.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) in acceptOwnership: access-control gate for ownership transfer.
balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] debited with safeSub inside transferFrom.
